    CodeDisplayDefinition
    within-normal-limitsWithin normal limitsThe measurement or analysis falls within the normal range of the device normative (age-matched reference) database (typically p >= 5%).
    borderlineBorderlineThe measurement or analysis falls in the borderline range of the device normative database (typically 1% <= p < 5%).
    outside-normal-limitsOutside normal limitsThe measurement or analysis falls outside the normal range of the device normative database (typically p < 1%).

name: NormativeClassificationVS
title: Normative Classification Value Set
description:
Classification of an ophthalmic measurement or analysis against the device
normative (age-matched reference) database: within normal limits, borderline, or outside
normal limits. Used for the overall interpretation of OCT macula and OCT RNFL / optic nerve
head analyses, and for the per-subfield deviation category of the OCT macula profile.
Bindings are extensible, so device-specific percentile categories (e.g. p<5%, p<1%) may be
used when no concept here applies.
